name: the hyperdex
headline: The *Hyperdex*
say: And here is the first thing anyone sees: the Hyperdex. The name joins two words, hyper and index. The root of every domain is a Hyperdex: an index, and the first impression anyone has of you. It is part of the platform itself, not a feature of one creation. Every host serves one at its root, and every visitor's hive knows how to read it. Your business card is not the index; it is one entry in it. And a Hyperdex can take many shapes: a list, a honeycomb, a wall of cards, whichever view suits the people who come to it. Visit someone's domain, and their Hyperdex is how they greet you.
